principle: FlowDocs P0 surfaces must be classified by ownership before remediation. Vendor dependencies, docs-only editorial helpers, and tokenized reference CSS are not the same risk as duplicated Flow component, pattern, or template behavior.

../FlowDocs/apps/docs/icon-system.js.reason: Docs maps artifact names to semantic icons while icon glyph resolution is delegated to Flow component primitives.

../FlowDocs/apps/docs/component-foundati.reason: The file renders explanatory foundation trace content and delegates the card surface to the governed component demo bridge.

../FlowDocs/apps/docs/foundation-explore.reason: Foundation explorers are reference documentation for token behavior; they are allowed after Style Dictionary source exists and raw values remain governed.

../FlowDocs/apps/docs/primitive-referenc.reason: Primitive reference pages may explain primitive behavior after the primitive has typed/runtime source ownership.

../FlowDocs/apps/docs/foundation-visual-.reason: Foundation visual sections are editorial reference content, not Flow runtime ownership.

../FlowDocs/apps/docs/family-component-d.reason: Family documentation is docs content, but sections that behave like component detail structure should move into the component detail template.

vendorPrefixes.reason: Vendored chart/map/animation libraries are external docs dependencies and must not be counted as Flow runtime duplicates; channel ownership is governed separately.

tokenizedReferenceCssReason: Docs CSS may style documentation/reference demos when it consumes generated system tokens and does not define Flow component, pattern, or template behavior.
